canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Calcon Mutual Mortgage Llc denied {value} of its 2,013 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Calcon Mutual Mortgage Llc decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Calcon Mutual Mortgage Llc will deny any specific future application with 24.2% probability
Calcon Mutual Mortgage Llc is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Calcon Mutual Mortgage Llc discriminates or violates law
24.2% applies to Calcon Mutual Mortgage Llc's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
